lines.text: You just want everything to stop
Same people telling me I'm blessed
Everybody needs a piece of me
Built a life that people envy
Built a name they all respect
Funny how success can leave you
But none of that gets quiet
When the darkness starts to call
And I'm not looking for an ending
I'm just looking for a break
I don't wanna leave this world
I just wanna leave it for a bit
Sometimes I drive with no destination
Got a father that I miss
And old voicemails I still play sometimes
Got dreams that keep me moving
And scars that keep me real
Some days I just wanna feel nothing
I don't wanna leave this world
I just wanna leave it for a bit
Maybe I just need one night
Where the world doesn't ask for me
Somewhere the guilt can't find me
Somewhere I can hear myself again
Tomorrow I'll keep carrying the weight
